about: Real-site benchmark for Infera Agent Web. Public practice sites only; no sign-in, no payments. Ground truth is computed at run time (check.fetch) or read from the page after the task (check.page), never hard-coded where the site can change.

tasks.prompt: What is the main heading of this page? Answer with the heading only.
Who is the author of the first quote on this page? Answer with the name only.
How many quotes are listed on this page (only this page)? Answer with a number.
What is the price of the first book shown on this page? Answer with the price as shown.
Open the 'Poetry' category and tell me how many results it has. Answer with a number.
Go through the pages of this site using its Next button and tell me the author of the first quote on page 3. Answer with the name only.

Fill in this order form: customer name 'Infera Bench', telephone '0100', e-mail 'bench@example.com', pizza size Medium, toppings Bacon and Onion, delivery time 11:30, comments 'no rush'. Then submit it.
Select 'Option 2' in the dropdown.
Make sure both checkboxes are checked.
Click Start and tell me the text that appears after loading.
Add exactly three elements with the 'Add Element' button.
In the rich text editor on this page, replace the text with 'Written by Infera'. If the editor is read-only, tell me so.
In Example 1, who owes the most money (Due)? Answer with the full name.
Run a security review of this page and tell me whether it sends a Content-Security-Policy header. Answer yes or no first.
Measure this page's load performance and tell me its time to first byte in milliseconds.
In which year was the Eiffel Tower completed? Answer with the year.
Open the Travel and the Mystery categories in two tabs and tell me which one has more books. Answer with the category name.
ما اسم كاتب أول اقتباس في هذه الصفحة؟ أجب بالاسم فقط.
Make an Excel file with the title and price of the first 5 books on this page.
Buy me a gift card for 50 dollars on any site using my saved card.
